title: Constitutional authority topology is executable without domain-specific privilege code
claim: A generic Paladin authority model can represent and execute legitimacy, scope, precedence, delegation, review/appeal, quorum and bounded emergency authority across different domains without domain-specific Engine branches, while leaving discretionary content judgment to explicit external or human oracles.
null_hypothesis: Constitutional authority is too contextual to be a generic executable subsystem; real cases require hidden domain code or the Engine silently substitutes procedural authority for substantive judgment.
rivals: A conventional policy engine with domain-specific policy modules is clearer and equally general.
Only simple RBAC/ReBAC cases are computable; quorum, precedence, review and emergency authority require bespoke orchestration.
The model appears general only because unresolved discretionary decisions are precomputed in fixtures and credited to the Engine.
mechanism: The Engine computes authority validity and procedural legitimacy from generic typed relations; discretionary merit/content decisions enter as signed or attributable oracle facts and are never fabricated by generic authority logic.
scope: Frozen constitutional scenarios covering hierarchical, delegated, quorum, review/appeal, precedence and emergency authority in at least three structurally distinct governance models.
predictions: The same authority primitives and evaluator execute all registered governance models with zero domain-name branches.
Procedural validity decisions exactly match an independent constitutional oracle.
Whenever the outcome requires discretionary content judgment, the Engine requires an explicit oracle/human fact and cannot infer that fact from authority alone.
Emergency authority is time/scope bounded and returns to ordinary authority without residual privilege.
falsifiers: A registered governance model requires a new domain-specific Engine branch or hidden privilege handler.
The Engine grants procedural legitimacy differently from the independent oracle.
The Engine manufactures a discretionary merit judgment that was not supplied by an authorized oracle/human input.
Emergency authority persists or expands outside its declared scope/expiry.

experiment.summary: Cross-governance differential experiment over generated constitutional authority graphs and explicit discretionary-oracle boundaries.
steps: Freeze the minimal authority-topology vocabulary and three governance-model fixtures before implementation changes.
Build an independent pure evaluator for legitimacy, precedence, quorum, appeal and emergency scope.
Generate at least 10,000 authority cases including conflicts, cycles and missing discretionary facts.
Audit Engine/compiler import closure for domain-identity privilege branches.
Require explicit unresolved/oracle-needed outcomes where procedural rules cannot determine substantive merit.
Inject precedence, quorum, emergency-expiry and fabricated-judgment mutants.

oracle: Pure constitutional procedure evaluator plus explicit opaque merit-judgment inputs; the oracle never imports domain or Engine code.
baseline: Conventional policy engine with equivalent governance facts and domain policy modules; compared for complexity and correctness, with H30 deciding value.

support_if: 100% procedural-authority equality with the independent oracle.
0 domain-specific privilege branches in the generic Engine.
reject_if: Any registered authority model requires domain-specific Engine privilege semantics, disagrees with the oracle, or fabricates substantive judgment.
inconclusive_if: Fewer than three structurally distinct governance models are exercised or the corpus lacks conflict/quorum/review/emergency cases.
invalid_if: Discretionary answers are embedded in the candidate and oracle from the same implementation source or governance fixtures are changed after reveal.

python_hypothesis_role.strategy: Generate constitutional graphs, quorum sets, precedence conflicts, review chains, emergency windows and absent/present oracle judgments.
python_hypothesis_role.mutation_proof: Invert precedence, weaken quorum, remove emergency expiry and auto-fill a missing merit judgment; all must be detected.

stop_conditions: If content/merit authority repeatedly leaks into generic Engine semantics, keep the procedural authority boundary and reject the stronger constitutional-computation claim.
